commit_message: Align Claude ACP probes with launch environment
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the Claude-specific ACP discovery, setup, runtime identity, launch metadata, capability metadata, and diagnostics adapter on top of the ACP Foundation branch. Follow-up aligns version/auth discovery probes with the same CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTABLE environment used by the actual ACP launch, including WSL forwarding. Legacy Claude stream-json and Codex behavior remain unchanged.

## Validation

Authoring subtask only. Heavy Cargo, Windows, and Visual Validation are intentionally deferred to final ACP integration.
